title: Pieces taking shape
description: Individual cells gently appear and disappear across a fine geometric field.
useCase: Add quiet activity behind a short headline or product illustration.
interaction: Play or pause the changing grid
reducedMotion: A fixed set of faint cells remains visible with no relocation.
limitations: Decorative; does not represent a live heatmap. Cell positions are deterministic and recalculate on container resize.
look: Pale cool-grey field with a fine light grid of square cells, a few cells tinted soft blue-grey, edges fading out through a radial mask.
motion: Eighteen cells fade in and out on staggered 7 s ease-in-out loops, peaking at 0.3 opacity, each relocating to a new grid position after every cycle; a button pauses.
adapt: Cells are 18 `rect` elements from `makeCells` over a `cellSize` (36) SVG `pattern`; each runs `mg-gridpattern-fade` (7 s, peak .3) offset by `--delay`, and `relocate` moves it on `onAnimationIteration`. Tune count, `cellSize`, the keyframe and the `mask-image` falloff.
